````markdown
# stash

stash takes a snapshot of a project directory in under a second and restores it later. It needs no config files and runs no daemon.

Every chunk is checksummed with BLAKE3, and stash verifies each checksum on restore. stash prunes snapshots older than 30 days unless you tag them with `--keep`. That holds for a small project and for a 500-person monorepo.

## Install

```bash
brew install stash
stash init
```
````
